description: MCP connector definitions for Perplexity Enterprise Pro

connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.notes: OAuth preferred; PAT accepted. Minimal scope: repo:read for validation.

connectors.name: Notion
connectors.notes: OAuth integration token. Create at https://www.notion.so/my-integrations.

connectors.name: StackOne
connectors.notes: API key from StackOne dashboard under Settings > API Keys.

connectors.name: Cloudflare
connectors.notes: Scoped API token from Cloudflare dashboard. Minimal: Zone.Read.

connectors.name: Firecrawl
connectors.notes: API key from app.firecrawl.dev. Free tier includes 500 credits.

connectors.name: Make (Integromat)
connectors.notes: API key from Make dashboard under Profile > API Access.

connectors.name: Google Drive
connectors.notes: OAuth2. Create credentials at console.cloud.google.com. Redirect: http://localhost:8080.

connectors.name: Microsoft OneDrive
connectors.notes: OAuth via Azure App Registration. Minimal scope: Files.Read.

connectors.name: Discord
connectors.notes: Bot token from Discord Developer Portal. Minimal intent: GUILD_MESSAGES read.

connectors.name: Supabase
connectors.notes: Service role key from Supabase project Settings > API. Use anon key for read-only.

connectors.name: Sentry
connectors.notes: Auth token from Sentry Settings > Developer Settings > Auth Tokens. Minimal: org:read.
